scientific_question: Can causal direction be identified from public do-intervention observations when the three observable sensor channels are arbitrarily permuted and no causal node identities or candidate edges are supplied?

hypotheses.chain: Base latent variables z0~Bern(1/2); z1=z0 XOR Ber(p); z2=z1 XOR Ber(q). Directed graph z0->z1->z2.
hypotheses.fork: Base latent variables z1~Bern(1/2); z0=z1 XOR Ber(p); z2=z1 XOR Ber(q). Directed graph z1->z0,z1->z2.
hypotheses.permutation: All 6 bijections from base latent variables z0,z1,z2 to three visible sensor slots s0,s1,s2. Sensor slot labels are public arbitrary addresses; graph identities and permutations hidden from inference.
hypotheses.passive: Observe only three binary sensor bits after generating all three equations. With equal root prior and symmetric edge noise, a chain and fork with the same permutation have identical passive P(s0,s1,s2).
hypotheses.intervention: For each public sensor slot i and do-value a in {0,1}, replace the structural equation of its unknown underlying z with z=a. Observe the full three-sensor output. Intervened sensor address and assigned value are public, causal graph not public.
hypotheses.population_observable: For each ordered distinct sensor pair (i,j), E[s_j|do(s_i=1)]-E[s_j|do(s_i=0)] as exact rational; this is a measured intervention effect, not a supplied candidate edge.
hypotheses.discovery_target: Recover the 3x3 directed causal ANCESTOR reachability matrix from observed population intervention effects; zero for nonancestors, positive products for ancestors. Does not purport to recover unique direct edge identity from finite samples.

candidate_states: 12 distinct parameterized latent cases per family = {chain,fork} x 6 permutations. Many have equivalent observational passive distributions; interventional effects must distinguish their directed reachability patterns.

information_tests.exact_population: Exhaustive enumeration of root bit and two independent binary edge-noise bits, with Fraction exact masses. Evaluate passive 8-state distributions and 6 intervention actions per latent candidate.
information_tests.intervention_structure_disambiguation: Every pair of latent candidates with distinct causal-ancestor matrices must have unequal full 6-pair effect signatures.
information_tests.symbolic_independent_control: Graph traversal of permuted structural equations derives ancestor presence, compared to positivity of exact population intervention-effect signature.
information_tests.bayesian_oracle_control: Exhaustive exact likelihood distributions for all 12 candidates across all 6 do-actions; confirm equality of symbolic structural enumeration with directly tabulated intervention effects. Known structural hypothesis class is PRIVILEGED theoretical reference, not an empirically trained learner.
information_tests.causal_mediation_check: When chain has length-two path, intervention-effect along long path must equal product of the two direct transmission effects.
information_tests.resource_accounting: Record process_time and tracemalloc peak of exact proof, no learned efficiency claims.
